headline: On October 27, 1981: Soviet Submarine S-363 Runs Aground in Sweden
captionCards: Soviet sub S-363 grounded in Swedish waters, 1981
Event highlighted Cold War tensions and espionage
instagramCaption:
A Soviet submarine found itself in Swedish waters. \\[The Soviet submarine S-363 ran aground on the east coast of Sweden, sparking a diplomatic incident. The Cold War, a period of intense geopolitical rivalry between the US and USSR, saw no direct fighting but was marked by espionage, proxy wars, and technological competition. This event highlighted the tension and mistrust between the two superpowers.\\Why does it still matter?
